criteria.criterion: Injecting the shared CriteriaError during real criteria assembly yields an unsigned fail-closed verdict with verdict: INDETERMINATE, llm_ran: false, full DET coverage, a distinct config-fault field, and no affirmative llm_unavailable field.

The config-fault diagnostic explicitly names the running INSTALLED REBAR BUILD as the suspect and directs the reader to use the repository checkout build; it preserves the original parse diagnostic without using string matching to classify it.
A negative-control genuine LLMUnavailableError still produces llm_unavailable: true; a healthy fake-provider control still runs the LLM tier and never reports a config fault.

The structured failure kind is carried from the exact criteria exception at the assemble boundary and documented in that step's output contract. Other assemble/runtime failures are not silently reclassified as criteria config faults.

DET behavior is unchanged: the config-fault verdict carries the same deterministic findings/counts as the existing degraded path, and a deterministic blocker remains BLOCK rather than being masked by INDETERMINATE.
Focused regression tests, relevant workflow/plan-review tests, make lint, and make typecheck pass.
